title: Vertical Sleeve Gastrectomy Procedure in Mice
author: Teri Stevenson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zcjf2un

steps.title: Preoperative Animal Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the mice for surgery by managing housing, diet, and initial medication.

substeps.instruction: Singly-house all animals.
Remove all bedding from cages.
Administer Ensure 12 hours before surgery.
Administer preoperative pain medication: Ketoprofen (5 mg/kg).

steps.title: Surgical Positioning and Sterilization
steps.instruction: Prepare the mouse for the operation on the surgical field.

substeps.instruction: Ensure adequacy of anesthesia.
Place mouse on a surgical board/field over a warm water circulating blanket and immobilize gently.
Prep and drape the animal sterilely.

steps.title: Abdominal Access
steps.instruction: Perform a midline laparotomy to expose the stomach.

substeps.instruction: Make a midline laparotomy incision with sharp surgical scissors, staying on the linea alba and away from the rectus abdominus muscles.
Gently sweep intestinal contents using cotton swabs until the stomach is located.

steps.title: Stomach Isolation and Ligation
steps.instruction: Isolate the stomach and secure the blood supply.

substeps.instruction: Gently cut away all connective tissue around the stomach.
Ligate the vessel attached to the greater curvature of the stomach using a cautery pen or 7-0 PDS II.
Place ligatures on all stomach vessels using 7-0 PDS II.

steps.title: Gastrectomy Procedure
steps.instruction: Remove the greater curvature of the stomach and close the organ.

substeps.instruction: Suture a continuous line below the ligatures using 6-0 monofilament suture.
Remove the greater curvature of the stomach by cutting below the ligated vessels and the monofilament suture line.
Close the stomach using a 7-0 PDS II continuous pattern.

steps.title: Abdominal Closure
steps.instruction: Close the abdominal wall in two layers.

substeps.instruction: Close the first layer (muscle) in a simple, interrupted fashion using 6-0 monocryl suture, suturing the connective tissue rather than the muscle proper.
Close the second layer (skin) in a simple, interrupted fashion using 7-0 Prolene suture.

steps.title: Immediate Postoperative Care
steps.instruction: Provide immediate recovery support and hydration.

substeps.instruction: Administer 1.0 ml of warmed, sterile saline following the procedure.
Place mice in recovery cages.

steps.title: Postoperative Recovery and Monitoring
steps.instruction: Manage the mice during the recovery period (typically 7-14 days).

substeps.instruction: Keep cages partially on a veterinary-approved heating pad for 5 to 7 days postoperatively.
Maintain an Ensure diet for 24 hours post-surgery with no bedding in the cage.
Administer post-op pain medication: Ketoprofen (5 mg/kg) immediately post-op and again at 24 hours postoperative.
Monitor general behavior (bright/alert/responsive vs. depressed/obtunded) until recovered.
Administer additional pain medication if needed based on recovery.
